newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ SLUMP TO SIXTH CONSECUTIVE DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PAU-ORTHEZ SLUMP TO SIXTH CONSECUTIVE DEFEAT.

text.p: Pau-Orthez lost almost all hope of reaching the last 16 in the basketball EuroLeague when they slumped to their sixth consecutive defeat against European champions Panathinaikos 78-66 on Wednesday.

Without injured star Antoine Rigaudeau and despite a fine scoring performance by American Lawrence Funderburke, the French champions lost ground when playmaker Thierry Gadou was excluded for five fouls.

Inspired by Italian Hugo Sconochini, who scored three times in a row after Gadou's dismissal, Panathinaikos quickly went 10 points up (58-48) halfway though the second half and held that lead until the end.

Far better organised, especially in defence, the Greeks wore the French down in the first half in which only Funderburke's efficency allowed Pau-Orthez to reach the break with a one-point lead (33-32).

But in their effort to keep in touch the French made far too many mistakes, which eventually proved very costly as they did not score a single point in the six minutes which followed Gadou's dismissal, while Panathinaikos scored 17.
